messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOMATED PAGE fired — p99 inference latency > 1.2s for service: runtime-text-gen (alert id PD-87654). Top affected route: /v1/chat (eu-west).

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-87654 triggered and routed to on-call (escalation policy: inference-p99).

Maya Patel: acked — looking. grabbing logs and perf dashboard.

AJ: oncall-rotation assigned to AJ for first responder. any customer-facing impact?

Maya Patel: preliminary: higher tail on eu-west, about 7% of requests hitting >1.2s p99, error rate normal. Most long tails from model-variant xsmall-quant.

Luis: seeing KV cache miss bursts and GPU queue depth climbing on host rwinference-eu-12. Could be autoscaler not spinning up fast enough or a noisy tenant.

Tara: I'm pulling tenant traces now — looks like a burst from tenant_id=acme-marketing at ~1736499900. They sent several large batched prompts (long context).

Samir: If batch sizes spiked we could hit memory pressure -> GPU eviction -> synchronous fallbacks. Suggest temporarily cap batch size via runtime flag.

AJ: agreed. Plan: 1) cap per-request batch size to 8, 2) enable alternate model variant (xsmall-fast) for non-enterprise routes, 3) scale up autoscaler target replicas + add warm instances, 4) notify PD if pages continue. Who can flip caps?

Maya Patel: I can update runtime config for caps. Pushing a quick knob change to feature flags.

Maya Patel: (pushing) /configs/runtime/batching -> set max_batch_tokens=4096, max_requests_in_batch=8

Maya Patel: command I ran:
```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \ 
  https://internal-api.redwood/v1/runtime/configs/batching \ 
  -d '{"max_requests_in_batch":8,"max_batch_tokens":4096}'
```

incident-bot: config change recorded (change id CFG-4421).

Luis: starting horizontal scale on eu-west pool +2 GPUs. kubectl output:
```
kubectl scale deployment runtime-eu-west --replicas=12
scaled deployment "runtime-eu-west" to 12
```

Tara: routing rule update: divert non-SLA traffic to model xsmall-fast. Applying policy: route by header X-Customer-Tier != "enterprise" -> model=xsmall-fast.

Samir: also bumped kvcache size on that host to reduce eviction churn: redis-cli -h kvcache-eu-12 config set maxmemory 8gb (temporary).

AJ: good. please monitor dashboards and post p95/p99 numbers every 2 min.

Maya Patel: first 2m after changes: p99 dropped from 1.35s -> 890ms, p95 steady ~210ms. CPU/GPU queue depth dropping.

Tara: noisy tenant rate-limited at infra edge (wrote rule to 10rps). That should stop new flood.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-87654 updated: status = acknowledged.

Maya Patel: customers impacted — up to 3 in the last 10m had responses >1s. No user-facing errors. Recommend post-incident email to affected customers with note about degraded tail. Anyone want to own comms?

AJ: I'll draft a short note. Keep it factual: what happened, mitigation steps, and ETA for permanent fix.

Luis: root cause hypothesis: large batched prompts from one tenant triggered prolonged GPU KV cache cold starts combined with autoscaler spin-up lag. Follow-ups: add burst protection, improve autoscaler responsiveness, and consider prewarmed instances for high-risk model variants.

Samir: filing follow-up task: INF-2142 - autoscaler warm pool + tenant burst protection. Also INF-2143 - improve kv-cache sizing heuristics.

Maya Patel: re-checking metrics — 10m after: p99 ~350ms, p95 ~190ms. GPUs look healthy.

AJ: closing the pager in 10 if stable. any objections?

Tara: none here. continuous monitoring on.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-87654: status changed to resolved by AJ (incident lasted ~6m). (note: automated resolution after 6m of stable metrics).

AJ: thanks all. Follow-ups: Samir/Luis to own the infra tickets, Maya & Tara to add alert refinement (snooze noisy tenant spikes) and runbook update for similar KV-cache burst. I'll file incident postmortem template and assign owners.

Maya Patel: adding notes to postmortem doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2142 (temporary link).

oncall-rotation: handed back to rotation schedule — AJ out in 30min. :thumbsup:

Samir: quick note — next week we'll test warm-pool behavior in staging with synthetic burst to validate autoscaler changes.

AJ: good. closing thread. Thanks for fast responses. :white_check_mark:
